name: What is considered a luxury second home in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a luxury second home in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury second home in South Florida typically refers to properties with premium features, high-end finishes, desirable locations like waterfront or exclusive communities, and often a higher price point than the average home. These properties frequently offer amenities such as private pools, smart home technology, expansive views, and concierge services. For buyers in areas like Miami Beach or Bal Harbour, this can mean oceanfront condos or estates offering direct beach access and enhanced privacy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury second homes in South Florida feature premium amenities, high-end finishes, and desirable locations, often with a higher price point. Properties in areas like Miami Beach or Bal Harbour may offer oceanfront views or direct beach access.
